title: Debug Empty Screenshot
description: When a Godot capture comes back showing only background or the artifact is tiny/invisible, follow this decision tree to find and fix the problem.
earned_from: joints visual upgrade — GimbalStabilizer was tiny because JointDemoBase Camera3D overrode capture camera

nodes.label: Screenshot empty or artifact tiny
nodes.detail: Capture ran but the image shows only background or a tiny speck

nodes.label: Does artifact create its own Camera3D?
nodes.detail: Search the .gd for Camera3D.new() or check if base class (like JointDemoBase) creates one with current=true

nodes.label: Disable artifact cameras recursively
nodes.detail: Walk all children, if child is Camera3D set current=false. Then set capture camera current=true.

nodes.label: Does artifact create its own WorldEnvironment?
nodes.detail: If yes, it provides its own background — skip adding ground plane (it will z-fight or look wrong)

nodes.label: Skip ground plane for self-lit scenes
nodes.detail: Don't add the capture script's ground plane. The scene's own dark background is better.

nodes.label: Is AABB height > 0.01?
nodes.detail: If AABB height is near zero, the mesh isn't generating geometry. If it has height, the mesh exists but is invisible.

nodes.label: Check if _process() runs during capture
nodes.detail: The capture script's await timer may not tick the scene's _process. Pre-run the simulation in _ready() instead: for i in range(N): _step_sim()

nodes.label: Is mesh using custom ArrayMesh with flat quads?
nodes.detail: Custom ArrayMesh quads can have wrong triangle winding. Normals point UP but vertices wind clockwise → back-face culled.

nodes.label: Set CULL_DISABLED on the material
nodes.detail: crack_material.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED — fixes back-face culled custom meshes

nodes.label: Is camera distance >> artifact size?
nodes.detail: If base_distance is 20+ but artifact visible geometry is 2m, the AABB includes invisible physics bodies or labels inflating the bounds.

nodes.label: Override distance multiplier or use manual --distance
nodes.detail: Current multiplier is max_dim * 1.0. For flat artifacts (AABB height near 0), max_dim is the width, so distance scales with the floor not the content.
